title: 4 Passengers injured after an escalator at the crowded Rajiv Chowk Metro station
text: Four passengers were injured after an escalator malfunctioned at the crowded Rajiv Chowk Metro station. Emergency services quickly responded to evacuate the injured commuters from the affected area.

title: इंदौर में लिफ्ट मैकेनिक की हादसे में मौत
text: Indore में लिफ्ट मैकेनिक की हादसे में एक जन की मौत हो गई। स्थानीय अधिकारियों ने घटना की जांच शुरू की है।

title: Maharashtra: Three children rescued after lift malfunctions in Municipal Corporation building in Kasarvadavali
text: Three children were trapped and later rescued after a lift malfunctioned inside a Municipal Corporation building in Kasarvadavali, Maharashtra. Fire and rescue personnel broke open the lift shaft to evacuate the children safely.

title: Woman Injured in Lift Malfunction at Kolkata Mall
text: A woman was seriously injured and rushed to hospital after a lift malfunctioned and fell suddenly at a major shopping mall in Kolkata. Emergency teams rescued her from between floors.

title: Lift Cable Snaps at Maharashtra Construction Site, Two Workers Injured
text: A lift cable snapped at an under-construction building in Maharashtra, sending the cabin crashing and leaving two construction workers with severe injuries. Site operations were suspended pending investigation.

title: Hospital Lift Trap in Delhi Sparks Regulatory Crackdown
text: A hospital lift in Delhi malfunctioned and trapped six patients and staff for over two hours, prompting local authorities to re-inspect all critical infrastructure lifts across the city. A similar incident in a Telangana metro station compound the concern.
